mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that prompt equity investors to reduce risk exposure, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.8% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a 60-day negative S&P 500 return as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 2% in 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 days as corporate margins are pressured by rising input costs.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO declines by more than 2% over 3 months, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDP growth above 3.0% annually), a decline in residential construction (HOUST) signals an impending demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 3.0%), a decline in HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate activity.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 5-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.
